title: Enterprise AI & Automation Briefing
summary: Sunday's enterprise AI tape centered on governed agents moving from demos into control planes: Microsoft pushed Copilot toward delegated work and natural-language automation, Okta assembled a multi-vendor security architecture for agent identity and runtime controls, Accenture and Teradata emphasized operational context for production agents, and Palo Alto, Workiva, Docusign, SoundHound, Salesforce, and Siemens showed domain-specific agent deployments across cyber, regulatory, agreements, voice, and industrial workflows.

stocks.name: Microsoft
stocks.role: Enterprise AI work hub and automation platform
stocks.does: Provides cloud infrastructure, productivity software, developer tools, cybersecurity, business applications, gaming, and AI services through Azure, Microsoft 365, GitHub, and Copilot.
stocks.briefing: Microsoft's late-week Copilot update brought Home, Code, and Autopilot into one work hub, adding delegated task execution, natural-language app and automation building, Office file editing inside Copilot, and deeper grounding through Fabric IQ, Work IQ, and a Plugin Registry.

stocks.name: Accenture
stocks.role: AI transformation and process automation integrator
stocks.does: Provides consulting, managed services, technology implementation, outsourcing, cloud, cybersecurity, data, and AI transformation services for large enterprises.
stocks.briefing: Accenture invested in and partnered with Within to help clients map how work actually happens, identify automation opportunities, deploy AI agents, and move from process discovery into agentic operating-model reinvention.

stocks.name: Okta
stocks.does: Provides identity and access management software for workforce, customer, developer, machine, and AI-agent identities.
stocks.briefing: Okta announced the Blueprint Alliance, positioning agent identity, least-privilege access, traceable delegation, runtime monitoring, and containment as shared requirements for the secure agentic enterprise.

stocks.name: Amazon.com
stocks.role: Cloud infrastructure member of agent security alliance
stocks.does: Operates e-commerce, logistics, advertising, streaming, devices, and Amazon Web Services cloud infrastructure and AI services.
stocks.briefing: Amazon Web Services was named a founding member of Okta's Blueprint Alliance, tying AWS to the emerging reference architecture for discovering, governing, and trusting enterprise AI agents across cloud environments.

stocks.name: CrowdStrike
stocks.does: Provides cloud-delivered endpoint protection, threat intelligence, identity protection, cloud security, log management, and security operations through the Falcon platform.
stocks.briefing: CrowdStrike joined Okta's Blueprint Alliance and framed its role around securing the agentic enterprise with interoperable runtime controls and security signals as enterprises deploy AI agents at scale.

stocks.name: Alphabet
stocks.role: Google Cloud agent platform and security participant
stocks.does: Operates Google Search, YouTube, Android, advertising platforms, Google Cloud, AI models, and enterprise productivity software.
stocks.briefing: Google Cloud was a founding Blueprint Alliance member, reinforcing Alphabet's position in enterprise agent platforms and open standards for zero-trust governance, traceable delegation, and lifecycle protection.

stocks.name: Salesforce
stocks.role: Agentic CRM and enterprise AI control plane
stocks.does: Provides cloud CRM, sales, service, marketing, Slack collaboration, data, analytics, integration, and AI agent platforms for enterprises.
stocks.briefing: Salesforce appeared in two enterprise-agent threads: it joined Okta's Blueprint Alliance through MuleSoft's Agent Fabric governance work, and its Siemens partnership uses Agentforce with Teamcenter to put engineering-grade answers into sales, service, and customer workflows.

stocks.name: ServiceNow
stocks.role: Workflow governance and autonomous work platform
stocks.does: Provides cloud workflow software for IT, employee, customer, creator, security, risk, and operations service management.
stocks.briefing: ServiceNow was named a Blueprint Alliance founding member, extending the narrative that enterprises need workflow governance, orchestration, and traceability before AI agents can act safely across systems.

stocks.name: Zscaler
stocks.does: Provides cloud security, secure web gateway, zero-trust network access, data protection, and threat prevention services.
stocks.briefing: Zscaler joined Okta's Blueprint Alliance and positioned zero trust as a control layer for how AI agents connect, act, and access enterprise data across modern environments.

stocks.name: Palo Alto Networks
stocks.does: Provides network security, cloud security, endpoint protection, security operations, threat intelligence, and zero-trust cybersecurity platforms.
stocks.briefing: Palo Alto Networks launched Unit 42 Continuous Frontier AI Defense, an annual subscription service that uses a multi-model AI harness to continuously test enterprise apps, APIs, cloud infrastructure, source repositories, and networks for exploitable exposures.

stocks.name: Teradata
stocks.does: Provides cloud data warehousing, analytics, data management, and AI services for large enterprises.
stocks.briefing: Teradata transformed Tera into an agentic coworker for enterprise data work, adding Context Engine, Tera Harness, and Agent Skills so analysts, engineers, DBAs, and data scientists can automate governed data workflows.

stocks.name: SoundHound AI
stocks.does: Provides voice AI, conversational AI, restaurant ordering automation, automotive voice assistants, and agentic AI platforms for enterprise and device customers.
stocks.briefing: SoundHound introduced OASYS Edge, bringing fully embedded agentic voice AI to vehicles and smart devices so manufacturers can build an agent once and deploy it in cloud, edge, or hybrid environments.

stocks.name: Workiva
stocks.does: Provides cloud software for financial reporting, sustainability reporting, audit, risk, compliance, and regulatory disclosure workflows.
stocks.briefing: Workiva unveiled Agent Studio at Amplify 2026, giving finance, accounting, sustainability, risk, and compliance teams tools to build, customize, deploy, and schedule governed AI agents inside Workiva workflows.

stocks.name: Docusign
stocks.does: Provides electronic signature, contract lifecycle management, agreement workflow, identity verification, and intelligent agreement management software.
stocks.briefing: Docusign's Agreement Layer remained in focus ahead of its September 30 MCP Server opening, which is designed to let enterprise agents act on agreement data and workflows through governed contract context.

stocks.name: Siemens AG
stocks.does: Provides industrial automation, digital industries software, infrastructure technology, mobility systems, healthcare technology through Siemens Healthineers, and industrial services.
stocks.briefing: Siemens deepened its Salesforce partnership by connecting Teamcenter Service Lifecycle Management with Agentforce, giving industrial sellers, service technicians, and customers access to engineering-grade product answers in front-office workflows.
